pairs.registryProposal: The subject assumes a source to target translation unit. It says nothing about an LLM generating candidate-facing prose directly in the target language from a language directive. That output has the same moving-engine and per-language quality risk but no source to compare against, so a boundary line naming which subject governs it would stop seats from forcing this subject onto it.
